## Change

Describe the concrete behavior and affected services.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm validate:data`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] UI changes include desktop/mobile screenshots and keyboard checks, or are not applicable.

## Operations

Describe monitoring/data changes, deployment requirements and remaining unknowns. Separate local verification from live or deployed evidence.

- [ ] Documentation and Memory Bank updated where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or invented observations included.
